caption: The drawing features a detailed front view of a one-piece garment, cream or light beige in color, with short, puffed sleeves and an elaborately decorated bodice. The bodice is adorned with symmetrical dark linear patterns and looped embroidery, and small circular buttons or studs line the front and sides. There is a slightly flared and scalloped peplum at the waist above straight, high-waisted, ankle-length pants that contain two slanted side pockets with contrasting dark outlines. A back view of the garment is sketched in a smaller scale in the upper right corner, showing the rear details including buttons down the back of the bodice and additional seam lines. The background of the drawing is a plain, neutral-toned paper, and the name “J. Peszel” appears in neat lettering at the lower right corner.
title: Boy's Suit
